pages.text: $(li)Use Silk Touch on spirit tree leaves to harvest EMC directly; automate leaf breaking with a Builder’s Wand or by placing leaves strategically for quick harvest.

$(li)For non-ME automation (e.g., furnace smelting), encode a 'Processing' pattern in the Pattern Terminal—ME exports inputs but expects finished products imported back manually or via automation.$(li)ME interfaces hit pattern capacity limits;
add Pattern Expansion Cards or extra interfaces as needed.

$(li)Chicken tier-up cannot be automated before unlocking the Roost; earlier, use manual or ComputerCraft/Integrated Dynamics logic.$(li)The Mech Coop bypasses chicken breeding entirely—no stats to manage—and provides passive eggs/mobs.

$(li)Chickens aren’t essential early; skip breeding until you can craft key eggs directly and use Mechanical Coops.$(li)You don’t need every chicken species—focus on high-yield types (4–8 ingots/egg) for temporary resource gains.

$(li)To automatically filter all items from a chest, encode Import/Export Interfaces like storage buses.$(li)Share EMC and knowledge with teammates by joining the same FTB team and enabling 'Share EMC' in team settings (team EMC starts at 0).

$(li)Share Extra Utilities 2 GP among teammates using $(5)/xu_powersharing$().$(li)At level 15, use Skill Crystals (from boss kills) to level up skills; combine desired enchantments onto one book via the Enchant Library (start with a level 15 book).
$(li)You can carry and level multiple data models simultaneously—pair with fast weapons (e.g., Mass Enchanted Flux Bow) or mob crushers + Time in a Bottle for efficiency.
